name: Desjungles
tagline: A banking app that switches to private voice mode when a second face looks at the screen and themes itself from the room.

awards: Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité

problem: The sponsor challenge asked for a banking app that adapts to the user's surroundings.
solution: Face detection triggers a spoken private mode when more than one person looks at the phone, ambient light sets the theme, and motion switches to a jungle scene, on top of transfers between accounts.
demo_moment: Team-described: lean in with a second person and the screen hides behind voice.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Turns shoulder-surfing into a design trigger.

lessons: Tie each sensor to one visible change in the interface.
